description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractDisplayField' used as a base for display fields in the OrangeHRM system's reporting module. It includes properties for report grouping, field identification, display attributes, and metadata annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: AbstractDisplayField
classes.description: An abstract base class for report display fields, providing common attributes and methods for subclasses including report grouping, visual attributes, sorting info, and database mapping annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Abstract method to set the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: getReportGroup
methods.description: Returns the associated ReportGroup entity.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Sets the associated ReportGroup entity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the display field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the display field.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for display purposes.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for display purposes.

methods.name: getFieldAlias
methods.description: Returns the optional alias for the database field.

methods.name: setFieldAlias
methods.description: Sets the optional alias for the database field.

methods.name: isSortable
methods.description: Indicates if the field is sortable (deprecated in favor of other mechanisms).

methods.name: setSortable
methods.description: Sets the sortable property (deprecated).

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order configuration (deprecated).

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order configuration (deprecated).

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Returns the sort field details (deprecated).

methods.name: setSortField
methods.description: Sets the sort field details (deprecated).

methods.name: getElementType
methods.description: Returns the type of the UI element.

methods.name: setElementType
methods.description: Sets the type of the UI element.

methods.name: getElementProperty
methods.description: Returns the element property string.

methods.name: setElementProperty
methods.description: Sets the element property string.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width configuration for display.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width configuration for display.

methods.name: isExportable
methods.description: Indicates if the field is exportable to reports (deprecated).

methods.name: setExportable
methods.description: Sets exportability (deprecated).

methods.name: getTextAlignmentStyle
methods.description: Returns text alignment style.

methods.name: setTextAlignmentStyle
methods.description: Sets text alignment style.

methods.name: isValueList
methods.description: Indicates if the field is a list of values.

methods.name: setIsValueList
methods.description: Sets whether the field is a value list.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Returns the display field group entity associated.

methods.name: setDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Associates a display field group entity.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for the field.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the field.

methods.name: isEncrypted
methods.description: Indicates if the field is encrypted.

methods.name: setEncrypted
methods.description: Sets the encryption flag.

methods.name: isMeta
methods.description: Indicates if the field is meta (deprecated).

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets the meta flag (deprecated).
